name: TC-16: Unauthorized user cannot apply to the challenge using 'Записатися на челендж' button
description: Verify that an unauthorized user cannot apply to the selected challenge and the disabled registration button displays the appropriate tooltip.
descriptionHtml: Verify that an unauthorized user cannot apply to the selected challenge and the disabled registration button displays the appropriate tooltip.

testStage.description: Verify that an unauthorized user cannot apply to the selected challenge and the disabled registration button displays the appropriate tooltip.

steps.name: Step 1: Click the 'Челендж' from the top menu
Step 2: Select 'Навчай українською челендж' from the dropdown menu
Step 3: Scroll to the 'Записатися на челендж' button
Check whether challenge registration button is enabled
Step 4: Hover over the disabled button and verify tooltip
